[[File:AsaSmoking-DM2.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Asa Naga]] smoking a cigarra]]
'''Smoking''' was a recreational drug activity in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It involved using dried [[Tobacco/Legends|tobacco]] or similar inhalants like [[Tabac/Legends|tabac]] or [[t'bac]], lighting it, and then absorbing the smoke via the nostrils or similar organs. Other drugs could also be smoked through a [[Hookah pipe/Legends|water pipe]]. Smoking was sometimes considered bothersome to the public, and for this reason was frequently banned from public areas or companies, including flights for the travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]].
